name: Drakness Thorne

pairing.pairBonus: When paired with Umbrath, Drakness assumes her Sundered form (combined art + bonus TBD).

abilities.name: Soul Harvest
abilities.description: Deal 90 shadow damage to a target; if it dies this turn, raise a Basic shade token.

lore: First of the Sundered — the Darkness that remained when the shard-storm broke. Where she walks, the dead lean closer to listen.

palette.eyeColor: Deep violet iris with obsidian limbal ring, radiating amethyst striations, and luminous lilac flecks
palette.hairColor: Rich obsidian-black with distinct ribbons of vibrant amethyst highlights and subtle espresso lowlights
palette.hairStyle: Center-parted and swept behind the shoulders, long and softly wavy, length to just below the bust-line (kept off the breasts) — shared Drak-sister standard length

physique.legs: Very long, slender; slim tapering thighs
physique.raceAlignment: Human, aligned to dark-elf characteristics (slender, elongated) — no pointed ears in glamour shots

meta.designNotes: First-pass stats; balance TBD. Transcendent marquee heroine (Darkness). Flagship pairing with Umbrath (UNIT_UMBRATH).
